source.title: Call for Applications - WCA Communication Team Leader (October 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

There will be an appointment of a new WCA Communication Team (WCT) Leader, as Zain Ali’s term is ending. We would like to thank Zain for the work he has done leading the Team.
<!-- break -->

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership and decision making skills
* Attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills with an ability to convey information clearly and professionally

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from **now until November 15th, 2025, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team ([assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)), CC’ing the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA
3. Ambitions as the WCT Leader

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WCT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2025.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.1%20-%20Communication%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 沟通团队招募负责人（2025 年 10 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

Zain Ali 的任期即将结束，WCA 沟通团队（WCT）将任命新负责人。感谢 Zain 在带领团队期间所做的工作。

申请者应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周投入至少 8 小时参与团队工作。我们希望申请者具备：

* 较强的领导和决策能力。
* 细心的工作态度。
* 出色的沟通能力，能够清晰、专业地传达信息。

申请材料提交时间为**即日起至 2025 年 11 月 15 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可私下将材料发送至执行助理团队（[assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)），并抄送 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：**

1. 简短的自我介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
3. 担任 WCT 负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WCT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2025.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.1%20-%20Communication%20Team.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将根据 [WCA 动议 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 5 节的规定投票选出新负责人，并公布结果。

感谢大家的申请和支持！
